questions.question: Go goroutines và channels là gì?

options.B: Goroutines: lightweight concurrent functions (go func()) quản lý bởi Go runtime; channels: typed conduit để communicate giữa goroutines (don't communicate by sharing memory, share memory by communicating)
options.C: Channels chỉ dùng để sync goroutines

questions.explanation: Goroutine: go func() { /* runs concurrently */ }(). Rất lightweight — vài KB stack, Go runtime schedule. Channel: ch := make(chan int); go func() { ch <- 42 }(); val := <-ch. Buffered channel: ch := make(chan int, 10). Select: select { case v := <-ch1: ... case ch2 <- x: ... case <-time.After(timeout): ... }. done channel pattern: done := make(chan struct{}); go func() { ...; close(done) }(); <-done. Context cancellation: ctx.Done() channel. CSP (Communicating Sequential Processes) model.

questions.question: Go interfaces — implicit implementation là gì?

options.A: Go interfaces phải khai báo 'implements' keyword
options.B: Go interfaces được implement implicitly — nếu type có tất cả methods của interface thì nó implement interface đó, không cần khai báo rõ; duck typing at compile time
options.C: Interface chỉ dùng được với structs

questions.explanation: type Stringer interface { String() string }. type Point struct { X, Y float64 }. func (p Point) String() string { return fmt.Sprintf('(%v, %v)', p.X, p.Y) }. Tự động implement Stringer — không cần 'implements Stringer'. fmt.Println(p) → gọi p.String(). Interface composition: type ReadWriter interface { Reader; Writer }. Empty interface: interface{} (any) accept mọi type. Type assertion: v, ok := x.(string). Type switch: switch v := x.(type) { case string: ...; case int: ... }. io.Reader, io.Writer là examples phổ biến.

questions.question: Go error handling — tại sao dùng multiple return values thay exceptions?

options.A: Go dùng try/catch như các ngôn ngữ khác
options.B: Go return (result, error) — caller phải explicitly handle errors; errors as values, không exceptions; errors.New(), fmt.Errorf('%w', err) để wrap
options.C: Panic/recover là cách chính xử lý errors

questions.explanation: Pattern: func readFile(path string) ([]byte, error) { f, err := os.Open(path); if err != nil { return nil, fmt.Errorf('open %s: %w', path, err); } defer f.Close(); return io.ReadAll(f) }. Caller: data, err := readFile('config.json'); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }. Sentinel errors: var ErrNotFound = errors.New('not found'). errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound). Custom error type: type ValidationError struct { Field string; Message string }; func (e *ValidationError) Error() string { return e.Message }. errors.As() để unwrap. Panic: chỉ cho truly unrecoverable (nil deref, index out of range).

questions.question: Go slices vs arrays — sự khác biệt quan trọng?

options.A: Slices và arrays giống nhau trong Go
options.B: Array: fixed-size, value type (copy khi assign). Slice: dynamic-size, reference type (header: pointer+len+cap), share underlying array
options.C: Slices không thể grow

questions.explanation: Array: [3]int{1,2,3} — size là type, pass by value (full copy). Slice: []int{1,2,3} hay make([]int, len, cap). Slice header: (ptr, len, cap). Append: s = append(s, 4) — có thể allocate new backing array. Sub-slice: s[1:3] chia sẻ backing array (modification ảnh hưởng original). copy(dst, src) để copy values. Gotcha: func modify(s []int) { s[0] = 99 } ảnh hưởng caller. Nhưng: func append_safe(s []int) []int { return append(s, 1) } phải return. Range loop: for i, v := range s — v là copy. 2D slice: [][]int.

questions.question: Go defer, panic, recover hoạt động thế nào?

options.B: defer: chạy trước khi function return (LIFO order); panic: terminate goroutine với stack unwind; recover: trong deferred function để catch panic và recover
options.C: panic không thể recover

questions.explanation: defer f.Close() → chạy khi surrounding function return (kể cả panic). Multiple defers: LIFO order (last defer, first out). defer với args evaluated immediately: defer fmt.Println(x) — x captured at defer time. Panic: func mustPositive(n int) { if n <= 0 { panic('must be positive') } }. Recover: func safeDiv(a, b int) (result int, err error) { defer func() { if r := recover(); r != nil { err = fmt.Errorf('recovered: %v', r) } }(); return a/b, nil }. Pattern: middleware dùng recover để catch panics từ handlers.

questions.question: Go structs và methods — receiver types?

options.B: Value receiver (func (t T) Method()): nhận copy; Pointer receiver (func (t *T) Method()): nhận reference, có thể modify. Interface satisfaction cần consistent receiver type
options.C: Tất cả receivers phải là pointers

questions.explanation: type Circle struct { Radius float64 }. func (c Circle) Area() float64 { return math.Pi * c.Radius * c.Radius } // value receiver — không modify. func (c *Circle) Scale(factor float64) { c.Radius *= factor } // pointer receiver — modify. Rule: nếu 1 method dùng pointer receiver → tất cả methods dùng pointer receiver (consistency). Interface: type Shape interface { Area() float64 }; var s Shape = Circle{...} // value; hoặc = &Circle{...} // pointer. Embedded struct: type ColoredCircle struct { Circle; Color string }. cc.Area() calls embedded Circle.Area(). Embedding ≠ inheritance.

questions.question: Go context.Context — tại sao quan trọng và cách dùng?

options.A: context chỉ dùng để pass values
options.B: Context: cancellation signal, deadline/timeout, request-scoped values; must be first parameter; propagate qua call chain; context.WithCancel, WithTimeout, WithValue
options.C: context không thể cancel goroutines
options.D: context chỉ dùng trong HTTP handlers

questions.explanation: ctx := context.Background(). ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 5*time.Second); defer cancel(). ctx, cancel = context.WithCancel(ctx); go func() { time.Sleep(2*time.Second); cancel() }(). Function: func fetchData(ctx context.Context, url string) ([]byte, error) { req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, 'GET', url, nil); return http.DefaultClient.Do(req) }. Select với ctx: select { case <-ctx.Done(): return ctx.Err(); case result := <-ch: return result, nil }. WithValue: ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, userKey, user). Best: dùng typed key để tránh collision. Always pass ctx as first arg.

questions.question: Go sync package — Mutex, WaitGroup, Once, RWMutex?

options.A: Channels là đủ, không cần sync package
options.B: sync.Mutex/RWMutex bảo vệ shared state; WaitGroup chờ goroutines; sync.Once cho initialization; sync.Map cho concurrent maps
options.C: sync package chỉ cho advanced users
options.D: Go channels replace tất cả sync primitives

questions.explanation: Mutex: type SafeCounter struct { mu sync.Mutex; count int }; func (c *SafeCounter) Inc() { c.mu.Lock(); defer c.mu.Unlock(); c.count++ }. RWMutex: nhiều concurrent reads, exclusive write: mu.RLock()/mu.RUnlock() cho reads. WaitGroup: var wg sync.WaitGroup; for i := 0; i < 5; i++ { wg.Add(1); go func() { defer wg.Done(); doWork() }() }; wg.Wait(). sync.Once: var once sync.Once; once.Do(func() { /* init once */ }). sync.Map: concurrent-safe map (read-heavy workloads). sync.Pool: reuse objects để reduce GC pressure.

questions.question: Go HTTP server với net/http package?

options.B: http.HandleFunc, http.Handler interface (ServeHTTP), http.ListenAndServe, custom mux (chi, gorilla/mux), middleware pattern
options.C: Go cần third-party framework để serve HTTP

questions.explanation: Basic: http.HandleFunc('/users', func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { if r.Method != http.MethodGet { http.Error(w, 'Method not allowed', http.StatusMethodNotAllowed); return }; json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(users) }). Custom handler: type Handler struct { db *sql.DB }; func (h *Handler) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { ... }. Mux: mux := http.NewServeMux(); mux.HandleFunc('GET /users', handler). Chi router: r := chi.NewRouter(); r.Use(middleware.Logger); r.Get('/users', getUsers). Server: srv := &http.Server{Addr: ':8080', Handler: mux, ReadTimeout: 5*time.Second}.

questions.question: Go generics (Go 1.18+) — tại sao cần và cách dùng?

options.B: Type parameters với constraints: func Map[T, U any](s []T, f func(T) U) []U — tái sử dụng code với type safety, không cần interface{} + type assertion
options.C: Generics chỉ dùng cho collections
options.D: interface{} là đủ, không cần generics

questions.explanation: Generic function: func Contains[T comparable](s []T, v T) bool { for _, e := range s { if e == v { return true } }; return false }. Constraint: type Number interface { int | int64 | float64 }; func Sum[T Number](nums []T) T { var total T; for _, n := range nums { total += n }; return total }. Generic type: type Stack[T any] struct { items []T }; func (s *Stack[T]) Push(v T) { s.items = append(s.items, v) }. Built-in: slices.Contains, maps.Keys. Avoid: không dùng generics khi interface là đủ. Compile-time type safety vs runtime interface{} assertion.

questions.question: Go testing — table-driven tests và benchmarks?

options.B: testing.T cho unit tests; table-driven tests với test cases slice; t.Run() subtests; benchmarks testing.B với b.N; testify cho assertions
options.C: Chỉ cần print statements để test

questions.explanation: Table-driven test: func TestAdd(t *testing.T) { tests := []struct { a, b, want int }{ {1, 2, 3}, {0, 0, 0}, {-1, 1, 0} }; for _, tt := range tests { t.Run(fmt.Sprintf('%d+%d', tt.a, tt.b), func(t *testing.T) { got := Add(tt.a, tt.b); if got != tt.want { t.Errorf('Add(%d, %d) = %d; want %d', tt.a, tt.b, got, tt.want) } }) } }. Benchmark: func BenchmarkAdd(b *testing.B) { for b.N { Add(1, 2) } }. go test -bench=. -benchmem. Testify: assert.Equal(t, expected, actual). Mock: testify/mock hoặc gomock. go test ./... -cover → coverage report.

questions.question: Go modules và dependency management?

options.B: go.mod defines module path và dependencies; go get để add; go mod tidy để clean; replace directive; vendor directory; workspace mode (go.work)
options.C: GOPATH là cách duy nhất

questions.explanation: go mod init github.com/user/project. go.mod: module path, go version, require (dependencies với versions). go get github.com/pkg/errors@v0.9.1. go mod tidy → add missing, remove unused. go mod vendor → vendor/ directory cho offline builds. Semantic versioning: v1.2.3, v0.x (no stability guarantee), major version suffix (github.com/user/mod/v2). replace: replace github.com/old/pkg => github.com/new/pkg v1.0.0. Workspace (Go 1.18+): go.work để develop multiple modules together. Private modules: GONOSUMCHECK, GOPRIVATE env vars.

questions.question: Implement Go HTTP API với chi router và middleware?

options.B: chi router với route groups, middleware chain, path params, request/response JSON encoding, custom middleware cho auth/logging
options.C: Chỉ dùng net/http là đủ

questions.explanation: r := chi.NewRouter(); r.Use(middleware.Logger, middleware.Recoverer, middleware.RealIP). r.Use(cors.Handler(cors.Options{AllowedOrigins: []string{'*'}})). r.Route('/api/v1', func(r chi.Router) { r.Use(JWTAuth); r.Get('/users', h.ListUsers); r.Post('/users', h.CreateUser); r.Route('/users/{userID}', func(r chi.Router) { r.Get('/', h.GetUser); r.Put('/', h.UpdateUser) }) }). Custom middleware: func JWTAuth(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { token := r.Header.Get('Authorization'); if !valid(token) { http.Error(w, 'Unauthorized', 401); return }; next.ServeHTTP(w, r) }) }. Path param: chi.URLParam(r, 'userID').

questions.question: Go database với sqlx hoặc GORM — patterns?

options.B: database/sql + sqlx cho type-safe scanning; GORM cho ORM approach; repository pattern, transactions, prepared statements, connection pool
options.C: GORM là bắt buộc cho Go databases

questions.explanation: sqlx: db, _ := sqlx.Connect('postgres', dsn). type User struct { ID int `db:'id'`; Name string `db:'name'` }. var users []User; db.SelectContext(ctx, &users, 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE active=$1', true). db.GetContext(ctx, &user, 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=$1', id). Transaction: tx := db.MustBeginTx(ctx, nil); tx.ExecContext(ctx, 'INSERT INTO users...' ); tx.Commit(). GORM: db.WithContext(ctx).Where('age > ?', 18).Find(&users). db.Create(&user). db.Model(&user).Updates(map). Preload: db.Preload('Orders').First(&user). Connection pool: db.SetMaxOpenConns(25); db.SetMaxIdleConns(5).

questions.question: Go concurrency patterns — worker pool, fan-out/fan-in?

options.A: Go không có built-in concurrency patterns
options.B: Worker pool: fixed goroutines consume from jobs channel; Fan-out: distribute work to multiple goroutines; Fan-in: merge multiple channels vào 1; errgroup cho coordinated goroutines
options.C: Chỉ dùng goroutines đơn giản

questions.explanation: Worker pool: jobs := make(chan Job, 100); results := make(chan Result, 100); for w := 0; w < numWorkers; w++ { go worker(jobs, results) }; for _, job := range workList { jobs <- job }; close(jobs); for result := range results { process(result) }. errgroup: g, ctx := errgroup.WithContext(context.Background()); for _, url := range urls { url := url; g.Go(func() error { return fetch(ctx, url) }) }; if err := g.Wait(); err != nil { ... }. Fan-in: func merge(cs ...<-chan int) <-chan int { var wg sync.WaitGroup; merged := make(chan int); output := func(c <-chan int) { for n := range c { merged <- n }; wg.Done() }; for _, c := range cs { wg.Add(1); go output(c) }; go func() { wg.Wait(); close(merged) }(); return merged }.

questions.question: Go gRPC implementation với protobuf?

options.B: protoc để generate Go code từ .proto; grpc.NewServer() với service implementation; client với grpc.Dial(); streaming RPCs; interceptors
options.C: gRPC chỉ cho microservices scale lớn

questions.explanation: .proto: service UserService { rpc GetUser (GetUserRequest) returns (UserResponse); rpc ListUsers (ListUsersRequest) returns (stream UserResponse); }. Generate: protoc --go_out=. --go-grpc_out=. user.proto. Server: type server struct { pb.UnimplementedUserServiceServer; db *sql.DB }; func (s *server) GetUser(ctx context.Context, req *pb.GetUserRequest) (*pb.UserResponse, error) { ... }; grpcServer := grpc.NewServer(grpc.UnaryInterceptor(loggingInterceptor)); pb.RegisterUserServiceServer(grpcServer, &server{db: db}). Client: conn := grpc.Dial('localhost:50051', grpc.WithTransportCredentials(insecure.NewCredentials())); client := pb.NewUserServiceClient(conn). Interceptors: logging, auth, rate limiting.

questions.question: Go JWT authentication middleware implementation?

options.B: golang-jwt/jwt package, parse + validate token trong middleware, context.WithValue để pass claims, chi middleware pattern
options.C: Phải implement JWT từ đầu
options.D: JWT không phù hợp với Go

questions.explanation: Sign: token := jwt.NewWithClaims(jwt.SigningMethodHS256, jwt.MapClaims{'sub': userID, 'exp': time.Now().Add(15*time.Minute).Unix()}); tokenString, _ := token.SignedString([]byte(secret)). Middleware: func JWTAuth(secret string) func(http.Handler) http.Handler { return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { tokenStr := strings.TrimPrefix(r.Header.Get('Authorization'), 'Bearer '); token, err := jwt.Parse(tokenStr, func(t *jwt.Token) (interface{}, error) { return []byte(secret), nil }); if err != nil || !token.Valid { http.Error(w, 'Unauthorized', 401); return }; claims := token.Claims.(jwt.MapClaims); ctx := context.WithValue(r.Context(), userKey, claims['sub']); next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(ctx)) }) } }.

questions.question: Go struct tags và JSON marshaling?

options.B: struct tags: `json:'name,omitempty'`; encoding/json Marshal/Unmarshal; custom MarshalJSON/UnmarshalJSON; json.Decoder cho streaming; number precision issues
options.C: JSON chỉ dùng map[string]interface{}
options.D: Go JSON không hỗ trợ nested structs

questions.explanation: type User struct { ID int `json:'id'`; Name string `json:'name'`; Password string `json:'-'` // excluded; Email string `json:'email,omitempty'`; CreatedAt time.Time `json:'created_at'` }. Marshal: data, err := json.Marshal(user). Unmarshal: var u User; err := json.Unmarshal(data, &u). HTTP: json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(user); json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&input). Custom: func (u *User) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) { type Alias User; return json.Marshal(&struct { Alias; Age int `json:'age'` }{Alias: Alias(*u), Age: u.CalculateAge()} }. Number precision: json.Number để tránh float64 precision loss.

questions.question: Go race conditions — detect và fix?

options.B: go run/test -race flag để detect; fix với sync.Mutex, channels, sync/atomic; avoid sharing mutable state giữa goroutines
options.C: Race conditions không xảy ra với channels
options.D: Chỉ cần dùng goroutines đúng cách

questions.explanation: Race detector: go build -race; go test -race ./.... Detect concurrent read/write trên same variable. Output: DATA RACE với stack trace. Common races: (1) Shared counter: var count int; go func() { count++ }() — fix: atomic.AddInt64(&count, 1) hoặc mutex. (2) Shared map: concurrent map reads/writes → panic. Fix: sync.RWMutex hoặc sync.Map. (3) Loop variable capture: for i := 0; ...; go func() { use(i) }() — fix: i := i; go func() { use(i) }(). (4) Shared slice: concurrent append → fix với mutex. (5) Closure capturing loop var in Go 1.22+: fixed by default.

questions.question: Go goroutine leaks — cách detect và prevent?

options.A: Goroutines không thể leak vì Go GC handles them
options.B: Goroutine blocked indefinitely → leak. Detect: goleak package trong tests, pprof. Fix: context cancellation, done channels, buffered channels
options.C: Goroutine leaks không ảnh hưởng production

questions.explanation: Common leaks: (1) Goroutine blocked on channel send khi no receiver: ch := make(chan int); go func() { ch <- 1 }() — channel never read. Fix: buffered channel hoặc select với done. (2) http.Get without timeout → goroutine wait forever. Fix: context timeout. (3) ticker không stop: t := time.NewTicker(1*time.Second); go func() { for range t.C { ... } }() — never stops. Fix: defer t.Stop(). goleak test: func TestSomething(t *testing.T) { defer goleak.VerifyNone(t); go leakyFunc() }. pprof: go tool pprof http://localhost:6060/debug/pprof/goroutine → xem goroutine count và stacks.

questions.question: Go nil pointer dereference — phòng tránh?

options.B: Check nil trước dereferencing; interface nil khác với typed nil; return (*Type)(nil) thay vì nil cho typed errors
options.C: Dùng recover() để catch nil dereference
options.D: Chỉ pointers nil, không phải interfaces

questions.explanation: Nil pointer: var p *int; *p = 1 → panic. Check: if p != nil { *p = 1 }. Interface nil confusion: var w io.Writer = (*os.File)(nil); w == nil // false! vì interface có type info. Proper nil: var w io.Writer = nil // w == nil true. Error pattern: type MyError struct { Code int }; func (e *MyError) Error() string { ... }; func getErr() error { var e *MyError = nil; return e } // không nil! caller: err != nil → true. Fix: return nil thay vì return typedNil. Pointer receivers trên nil: func (u *User) String() string { if u == nil { return 'nil user' }; return u.Name } — có thể handle nil safely.

questions.question: Go memory profiling với pprof?

options.B: pprof HTTP endpoint, go tool pprof để analyze heap, goroutine, CPU profiles; gcflags '-m' để xem escape analysis; runtime/debug.ReadGCStats
options.C: Chỉ cần giảm allocations là đủ

questions.explanation: Enable pprof: import _ 'net/http/pprof'. Heap: go tool pprof http://localhost:6060/debug/pprof/heap. CPU: go tool pprof http://localhost:6060/debug/pprof/profile?seconds=30. Commands: top (top allocators), list funcName (source with alloc), web (flame graph). Escape analysis: go build -gcflags='-m' 2>&1 | grep 'escapes to heap'. Common allocations: (1) Interfaces box values → alloc. (2) Closures capture variables → alloc. (3) Slices grow beyond cap → alloc. (4) String concatenation in loop → use strings.Builder. Optimization: sync.Pool để reuse objects. GOGC=100 (default), reduce for less GC.

questions.question: Go deadlock — nguyên nhân và fix?

options.B: Mutex lock order inconsistency, goroutines waiting on each other's channels, all goroutines blocked → 'all goroutines are asleep - deadlock!' panic
options.C: Deadlocks chỉ trong multi-threaded code

questions.explanation: Deadlock causes: (1) Unbuffered channel: main gửi but no receiver: ch := make(chan int); ch <- 1; go receive(ch) // deadlock. (2) Mutex re-lock: mu.Lock(); mu.Lock() → deadlock. (3) Circular wait: goroutine A lock(mu1) then lock(mu2), goroutine B lock(mu2) then lock(mu1). Fix: consistent lock order. (4) All goroutines blocked: no goroutine can make progress. Go runtime detect và panic. Debug: GOTRACEBACK=all go run → tất cả goroutine stacks. Context timeout: ctx với timeout để prevent infinite wait. tryLock (Go 1.18+): mu.TryLock() để avoid blocking.

questions.question: Go HTTP server graceful shutdown implementation?

options.B: os.Signal (SIGTERM/SIGINT) → server.Shutdown(ctx) với timeout → wait in-flight requests → exit; context với deadline
options.C: os.Exit(0) là đủ
options.D: Go HTTP server tự handle shutdown

questions.explanation: srv := &http.Server{Addr: ':8080', Handler: r}; go func() { if err := srv.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed { log.Fatal(err) } }(). quit := make(chan os.Signal, 1); signal.Notify(quit, syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM); <-quit; log.Info('Shutting down server...'). ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second); defer cancel(); if err := srv.Shutdown(ctx); err != nil { log.Fatal('Server forced to shutdown:', err) }. Shutdown: stop accepting new requests, wait for in-flight to complete, close connections. Also: close DB connections, flush logs, complete queue processing.

questions.question: Go microservice với gRPC và service mesh (Istio) — architecture?

options.A: Go không phù hợp cho microservices
options.B: gRPC cho inter-service communication, protobuf cho contracts, Istio service mesh cho observability/traffic management, health probes, graceful shutdown
options.C: REST là tốt hơn gRPC cho microservices
options.D: Service mesh không cần thiết với Go

questions.explanation: Architecture: Go services communicate via gRPC (typed, efficient binary protocol). Protobuf contracts version-controlled. Service mesh (Istio): mutual TLS between services, traffic management (canary, circuit breaking), distributed tracing (Jaeger), metrics (Prometheus). gRPC health check: grpc_health_v1.RegisterHealthServer(). Kubernetes: readiness (/healthz), liveness (/livez) probes. Service discovery: K8s DNS + Istio service registry. Retry/timeout: gRPC interceptors hoặc Istio retry policy. Observability: grpc interceptors → trace IDs → Jaeger. Config: environment variables từ ConfigMap/Secret.

questions.question: Go high-performance HTTP service — optimization techniques?

options.B: sync.Pool, zero-allocation patterns, fasthttp (alternative), connection keep-alive, worker pools, profiling với pprof, buffer reuse
options.C: Chỉ cần scale horizontally
options.D: Go không thể optimize HTTP performance

questions.explanation: Performance techniques: (1) sync.Pool: reuse buffers và objects. var bufPool = sync.Pool{New: func() interface{} { return new(bytes.Buffer) }}. (2) Pre-allocate slices: make([]Item, 0, expectedSize). (3) Avoid interface allocations trong hot paths. (4) String builder: var sb strings.Builder; sb.WriteString('...'). (5) fasthttp: 10x faster than net/http for raw throughput (trade-off: less compatible). (6) Zero-copy: io.Copy, ReadFrom. (7) Compression middleware. (8) Connection pool: http.Transport.MaxIdleConnsPerHost. (9) JSON: sonic/segmentio encoder (faster than encoding/json). Profile first: go test -cpuprofile + pprof → identify hotspots.

questions.question: Go CLI tool với cobra — design patterns?

options.A: Go không suitable cho CLI tools
options.B: cobra framework: root command, subcommands, flags (persistent/local), config với viper, testing CLI commands, cross-compilation
options.C: Chỉ cần os.Args parsing

questions.explanation: rootCmd := &cobra.Command{Use: 'myapp', Short: 'My CLI tool'}. var cfgFile string; rootCmd.PersistentFlags().StringVar(&cfgFile, 'config', '', 'config file'). Subcommand: serveCmd := &cobra.Command{Use: 'serve', Short: 'Start server', RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error { return startServer() } }; rootCmd.AddCommand(serveCmd). Viper: viper.SetConfigFile(cfgFile); viper.AutomaticEnv(); viper.BindPFlag('port', serveCmd.Flags().Lookup('port')). Config precedence: flags > env > config file > default. goreleaser cho cross-platform builds + GitHub Releases. Test: cmd.SetArgs(['serve', '--port', '8080']); cmd.Execute().

questions.question: Go production Docker image — best practices?

options.B: Multi-stage build: builder stage compile static binary, distroless/scratch final stage; CGO_ENABLED=0; non-root user; COPY binary only
options.C: Docker không cần cho Go apps
options.D: Alpine là tốt nhất cho Go

questions.explanation: Multi-stage: FROM golang:1.22-alpine AS builder; WORKDIR /app; COPY go.mod go.sum ./; RUN go mod download; COPY . .; RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build -ldflags='-w -s' -o server ./cmd/server. FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12; COPY --from=builder /app/server /server; USER nonroot:nonroot; EXPOSE 8080; ENTRYPOINT ['/server']. CGO_ENABLED=0: static binary, không cần libc. -ldflags='-w -s': strip debug info → smaller binary (50% reduction). distroless: không shell, không package manager → minimal attack surface. Image size: ~10MB vs ~800MB (golang:latest). Scan: docker scout cves myapp:latest.

questions.question: Go observability — structured logging, metrics, tracing?

options.B: slog (Go 1.21) cho structured logging, OpenTelemetry SDK, Prometheus client_golang, pprof endpoint, correlation IDs
options.C: Third-party logging là không cần thiết

questions.explanation: Structured logging (slog, Go 1.21): logger := slog.New(slog.NewJSONHandler(os.Stdout, nil)); logger.Info('request', 'method', r.Method, 'path', r.URL.Path, 'duration', duration). OpenTelemetry: tp := trace.NewTracerProvider(trace.WithBatcher(exporter)); otel.SetTracerProvider(tp); tracer := otel.Tracer('my-service'); ctx, span := tracer.Start(ctx, 'operation'); defer span.End(). Prometheus: http_requests_total := prometheus.NewCounterVec(prometheus.CounterOpts{Name: 'http_requests_total'}, []string{'method', 'status'}); http.Handle('/metrics', promhttp.Handler()). pprof: import _ 'net/http/pprof'.

questions.question: Go channel pipeline patterns cho data processing?

options.B: Stage-by-stage pipeline với channels, fan-out workers, errgroup cho error handling, context cho cancellation, backpressure với buffered channels
options.C: Go pipelines không scalable

questions.explanation: Pipeline: func generate(nums ...int) <-chan int { out := make(chan int); go func() { for _, n := range nums { out <- n }; close(out) }(); return out }. func square(in <-chan int) <-chan int { out := make(chan int); go func() { for n := range in { out <- n*n }; close(out) }(); return out }. c := generate(2, 3, 4); out := square(square(c)); for v := range out { fmt.Println(v) }. Cancellation: all stages receive ctx, select on ctx.Done(). Backpressure: buffered channels. Error propagation: separate error channel hoặc errgroup. Fan-out: multiple workers read same input channel. Merge: fan-in pattern.
